mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TR_MSTR (TID, ORG_TID, MCHT_ID, PM_CD, TX_ST_CD, AMT, TR_DT, TR_TM, CHANNEL, PAY_TYPE, ORDER_ID, GOODS_NM, CARD_NO_MASKED, USR_ID) VALUES (#{tid}, #{orgTid}, #{mchtId}, #{pmCd}, #{txStCd}, #{amt}, #{trDt}, #{trTm}, #{channel}, #{payType}, #{orderId}, #{goodsNm}, #{cardNoMasked}, #{usrId})

INSERT INTO TR_MSTR (TID, ORG_TID, MCHT_ID, PM_CD, TX_ST_CD, AMT, TR_DT, TR_TM, CHANNEL, PAY_TYPE, ORDER_ID, GOODS_NM, CARD_NO_MASKED, USR_ID) VALUES
(#{t.tid}, #{t.orgTid}, #{t.mchtId}, #{t.pmCd}, #{t.txStCd}, #{t.amt}, #{t.trDt}, #{t.trTm}, #{t.channel}, #{t.payType}, #{t.orderId}, #{t.goodsNm}, #{t.cardNoMasked}, #{t.usrId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TR_MSTR WHERE TID = #{tid} AND TX_ST_CD = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TR_MSTR WHERE TID = #{tid} AND TX_ST_CD = '2'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TR_MSTR WHERE CHANNEL = 'SEED' AND TID LIKE 'SEED%' AND SUBSTRING(TID, 5, 8) BETWEEN #{fromYmd} AND #{toYmd}
mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM TR_MSTR a LEFT JOIN TR_MSTR c ON c.TID = a.TID AND c.TX_ST_CD = '2' WHERE a.TR_DT = #{trDt} AND a.TX_ST_CD = '0' AND a.CHANNEL = 'LIVE' AND a.PM_CD = 'CARD' AND c.TR_SEQ IS NULL
